english: Om Sri Matha Namah - She who is the Mother, who gives immeasurable wealth, who removes all sorrows and gives only happiness - indicates also her role of creation.
Om Sri Maharajni Namah - She who is the empress who takes care of the universe- indicates her role of protection.
Om Sri Math Simasaneshwari Namah - She who sits on the throne of lions-indicates her role of destruction.
Om Chidagni Kunda Sambootha Namah - She who rose from the fire of knowledge and is the ultimate truth.
Om Deva Karya Samudhyatha Namah - She who is interested in helping devas.
Om Udyath Bhanu Sahasrabha Namah - She who glitters like thousand rising suns.
Om Chadur Bahu Samanvidha Namah - She who has four arms.
Om Ragha Swaroopa Pasadya Namah - She who has love for all in the form of rope (pasa) -She has this in one of her left hands.
Om Krodhakara Ankusojwala Namah - She who glitters and has anger in the form of Anghusa - i n one of her right hands. .
Om Mano Rupeshu Kodanda Namah - She who has the bow of sweet cane which is her mind - in one of her left hands.
Om Pancha Than Mathra Sayaka Namah - She who has five bows of touch, smell, hearing, taste and sight.
Om Nijaruna Prabha Poora Majjath Brahmanda Mandala Namah - She who makes all the universe immerse in her red colour which is like the sun in the dawn.
Om Champakasoka Punnaga Sowgandhika Lasathkacha Namah - She who wears in her hair flowers like Champaka, Punnaga and Sowgandhika.
Om Kuru Vinda Mani Sreni Kanath Kotira Manditha Namah - She whose crown glitters with rows of inlaid precious stones (Padmaraga stones).
Om Ashtami Chandra Vibhraja Dhalika Sthala Shobhitha Namah - She who has a beautiful forehead like the half moon (visible on eighth day from new moon).
Om Muka Chandra Kalankabha Mriganabhi Viseshaka Namah - She who has the thilaka (dot) of Musk in her forehead which is like the black shadow in the moon.
Om Vadana Smara Mangalya Griha Thorana Chillaka Namah - She who has beautiful eyelids which look like the ornaments to her face which is like cupids home.
Om Vakthra Lakshmi Parivaha Chalan Meenabha Lochana Namah - She who has beautiful eyes which look like fish in the pond of her face.
Om Nava Champaka Pushpabha Nasa Dhanda Virajitha Namah - She who has nose like freshly opened flowers of Champaka.
Om Thara Kanthi Thiraskari Nasabharana Bhasura Namah - She who has a nose ring which shines more than the star.
Om Kadambha Manjari Kluptha Karna Poora Manohara Namah - She who has beautiful ears like the kadamba flowers.
Om Thadanga Yugali Bhootha Thapanodupa Mandala Namah - She who wears the sun and the moon as her ear studs.
Om Padma Raga Sila Darsha Paribhavika Polabhu Namah - She who has cheeks which shine more than the mirror made of Padmaraga.
Om Nava Vidhruma Bimbha Sri Nyakkari Rathna Chhadha Namah - She whose lips are like beautiful new corals.
Om Shuddha Vidyangurakara Dwija Pangthi Dwayojjala Namah - She who has teeth which look like germinated true knowledge (Shodasakshari vidya).
Om Karpoora Veedi Kamodha Samakarsha Digandara Namah - She who chews betel leaf with the spices which give perfume in all directions.
Om Nija Sallabha Madhurya Vinirbhardista Kacchabhi Namah - She who has voice sweeter than the notes produced by Sarawathi Devis Veena (This is called Kachabhi).
Om Mandasmitha Prabha Poora Majjat Kamesha Manasa Namah - She who has lovely smile which is like the river in which the mind of cupid plays.
Om Anakalidha Sadrushya Chibuka Sri Virajitha Namah - She who has a beautiful chin which has nothing else to compare.
Om Kamesha Baddha Mangalya Sutra Shobitha Kandhara Namah - She who shines with the sacred thread in her neck tied by Lord Kameshwara.
Om Kankangadha Keyura Kamaniya Bujanvidha Namah - She who wears golden Armlets.
Om Rathna Graiveya Chinthaka Lola Muktha Phalanvitha Namah - She who wears necklace with moving pearls and dollar inlaid with gems.
Om Kameswara Prema Rathna Mani Prathi Pana Sthani Namah - She who gave her chest which are like the pot made of Rathna (precious stones) and has obtained the love of Kameshwara.
Om Nabhyala Vala Romali Latha Phala Kucha Dwayi Namah - She who has chest that is like fruits borne on the creeper of tiny hairs rising from her belly. .
Om Lakshya Roma Latha Dharatha Samunneya Madhyama Namah - She who is suspected to have a waist because of the creeper like hairs rising from there.
Om Sthana Bhara Dalan Madhya Patta Bhandha Valithraya Namah - She who has three stripes in her belly which looks like having been created to protect her tiny waist from her heavy chest.
Om Arunaruna Kausumba Vasthra Bhaswat Kati Thati Namah - She who shines in her light reddish silk cloth worn over her tiny waist.
Om Rathna Kinkinika Ramya Rasana Dhama Bhooshitha Namah - She who wears a golden thread below her waist decorated with bells made of precious stones.
Om Kamesha Gnatha Sowbhagya Mardworu Dwayanvitha Namah - She who has pretty and tender thighs known only to her consort, Kameshwara.
Om Manikhya Mukuta Kara Janu Dwaya Virajitha Namah - She who has knee joints like the crown made of manikya below her thighs.
Om Indra Kopa Parikshiptha Smarathunabha Jangika Namah - She who has forelegs like the cupids case of arrows followed by the bee called Indra kopa.
Om Kooda Gulpha Namah - She who has round ankles.
Om Koorma Prashta Jayishnu Prapadanvidha Namah - She who has upper feet like the back of the tortoise.
Om Nakadhi Dhithi Samchanna Namajjana Thamoguna Namah - She who removes the darkness in the mind of her devotees by the sparkle of nails.
Om Pada Dwaya Prabha Jala Parakrutha Saroruha Namah - She who has two feet which are much more beautiful than lotus flowers.
Om Sinchana Mani Manjira Manditha Sri Pamambuja Namah - She who has feet wearing musical anklets filled with gem stones.
Om Marali Mandha Gamana Namah - She who has the slow gait like the swan.
Om Maha Lavanya Sewadhi Namah - She who has the store house of supreme beauty.
Om Sarvaruna Namah - She who has light reddish colour of the dawn in all her aspects.
Om Anavadhyangi Namah - She who has most beautiful limbs which do not lack any aspect of beauty.
Om Srvabharana Bhooshita Namah - She who wears all the ornaments.
Om Shivakameswarangastha Namah - She who sits on the lap of Kameswara (Shiva).
Om Shiva Namah - She who is the personification of Shiva.
Om Swadheena Vallabha Namah - She whose husband obeys her.
Om Summeru Madhya Sringastha Namah - She who lives in central peak of Mount Meru.
Om Sriman Nagara Nayika Namah - She who is the chief of Srinagara (a town).
Om Chinthamani Grihanthastha Namah - She who lives in the all wish full filling house.
Om Pancha Brahmasana Sthitha Namah - She who sits on the five brahmas viz., Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra, Esana and Sadashiva.
Om Maha Padma Davi Samstha Namah - She who lives in the forest of lotus flowers.
Om Kadambha Vana Vasini Namah - She who lives in the forest of Kadmbha (Madurai city is also called Kadambha vana).
Om Sudha Sagara Madhyastha Namah - She who lives in the middle of the sea of nectar.
Om Kamakshi Namah - She who fulfills desires by her sight.
Om Kamadhayini Namah - She who gives what is desired.
Om Devarshi Gana-Sangatha-Stuyamanathma-Vaibhava Namah - She who has all the qualities fit to be worshipped by sages and devas.
Om Bhandasura Vadodyuktha Shakthi Sena Samavitha Namah - She who is surrounded by army set ready to kill Bandasura.
Om Sampathkari Samarooda Sindhoora Vrija Sevitha Namah - She who is surrounded by Sampathkari (that which gives wealth) elephant brigade.
Om Aswaroodadishidaswa Kodi Kodi Biravrutha Namah - She who is surrounded by crores of cavalry of horses.
Om Chakra Raja Ratha Rooda Sarvayudha Parishkridha Namah - She who is fully armed and rides in the Sri Chakra chariot with nine stories.
Om Geya Chakra Ratha Rooda Manthrini Pari Sevitha Namah - She who rides in the chariot with seven stories and is served by manthrini who is the goddess of music.
Om Giri Chakra Ratharooda Dhanda Natha Puraskrutha Namah - She who rides in the chariot with five stories and is served by goddess Varahi otherwise called Dhanda natha.
Om Jwalimalika Ksiptha Vanhi Prakara Madhyaka Namah - She who is in the middle of the fort of fire built by the Goddess Jwalamalini.
Om Bhanda Sainya Vadodyuktha Shakthi Vikrama Harshitha Namah - She who was pleased by the various Shakthis (literally strength but a goddess) who helped in killing the army of Bhandasura.
Om Nithya Parakamatopa Nireekshana Samutsuka Namah - She who is interested and happy in observing the valour of Nithya devathas (literally goddess of every day).
Om Banda Puthra Vadodyuktha Bala Vikrama Nandhita Namah - She who was pleased by the valour of Bala devi (her daughter) in destroying the sons of Banda.
Om Manthrinyamba Virachitha Vishangavatha Doshitha Namah - She who became happy at seeing Goddess Manthrini kill Vishanga (this ogre (brother of Banda) represents our desires for physical things).
Om Vishuka Prana Harana Varahi Veeerya Nandhitha Namah - She who appreciates the valour of Varahi in killing Vishuka (another brother of Banda-he is personification of ignorance).
Om Kameshwara Mukaloka Kalpitha Sri Ganeshwara Namah - She who created God Ganesh by the mere look of the face of her Lord, Kameshwara.
Om Mahaganesha Nirbhinna Vignayanthra Praharshitha Namah - She who became happy at seeing Lord Ganesha destroy the Vigna Yanthra (contraption meant to delay) created by Vishuka.
Om Banda Surendra Nirmuktha Sashtra Prathyasthra Varshani Namah - She who rained arrows and replied with arrows against Bandasura.

Om Karanguli Nakhothpanna Narayana Dasakrithi Namah - She who created the ten avatharas of Narayana from the tip of her nails (when Bandasura send the Sarvasura asthra (arrow), she destroyed it by creating the ten avatharas of Vishnu).
Om Maha Pasupathasthragni Nirdagdhasura Sainika Namah - She who destroyed the army of asuras by the Maha pasupatha arrow. .
Om Kameshwarasthra Nirdhagdha Sabandasura Sunyaka Namah - She who destroyed Bandasura and his city called sunyaka by the Kameshwara arrow. .
Om Brahmopendra Mahendradhi Deva Samsthutha Vaibhava Namah - She who is prayed by Lord Brahma, Vishnu, indra and other devas.
Om Hara Nethragni Sandhagdha Kama Sanjeevanoushadhi Namah - She who brought back to life the God of love Manmatha who was burnt to ashes by the fire from the eyes of Shiva.
Om Sri Vagbhave Koodaiga Swaroopa Mukha Pankaja Namah - She whose lotus face is Vagnhava Koota.
Om Kantatha Kadi Paryantha Madhya Koodaiga Swaroopini Namah - She whose portion from neck to hips is Madya koota.
Om Sakthi Koodaiga Thapanna Kadyatho Bhaga Dharini Namah - She whose portion below hips is the Shakthi koota.
Om Moola Manthrathmikha Namah - She who is the meaning of Moola Manthra (root manthra) or She who is the cause.
Om Moola Kooda Thraya Kalebhara Namah - She whose body is the three parts of the basic manthra i. e. Pancha dasakshari manthra.

Om Kulamruthaika Rasika Namah - She who enjoys the ecstatic state of oneness of one who sees, sight and what is seen or She who gets pleasure in drinking the nectar flowing from the thousand petalled lotus below the brain. .
Om Kula Sanketha Palini Namah - She who protects powerful truths from unsuitable people.
Om Kulangana Namah - She who is a lady belonging to cultured family or She who is like Sri Vidya known only to one whom it belongs.
Om Kulanthastha Namah - She who is fit to be worshipped any where.
Om Kaulini Namah - She who is the unification of the principles of Shiva and Shakthi.
Om Kula Yogini Namah - She who is related to the family or She who is related to the ultimate knowledge.
Om Akula Namah - She who is beyond kula or She who is beyond any knowledge.
Om Samayanthastha Namah - She who is within the mental worship of Shiva and Shakthi.
Om Samayachara That Para Namah - She who likes Samayachara i. e. worship stepwise from Mooladhara Chakra.
Om Moladharaika Nilaya Namah - She who exists in Mooladhara In Mooladhara which is in the form of four petalled lotus the kundalini sleeps. .
Om Brahma Grandhi Vibhedini Namah - She who breaks the tie in Brahma Grandhi i. e she who helps us to cross the ties due to our birth. .
Om Mani Poorantharudhitha Namah - She who exists in Mani Pooraka Chakra dressed in her fineries.
Om Vishnu Grandhi Vibedhini Namah - She who breaks the ties of Vishnu Grandhi i. e she who helps us cross the ties due to our position. .
Om Agna Chakarantharalastha Namah - She who lives in between two eye lids in the form of she who orders.
Om Rudra Grandhi Vibhedini Namah - She who breaks the ties of Rudra Grandhi i. e she who helps us cross the ties due to our violent thoughts and nature.
Om Sahararambhujarooda Namah - She who has climbed sahasrara the thousand petalled lotus which is the point of ultimate awakening.
Om Sudha Sarabhi Varshini Namah - She who makes nectar flow in all our nerves from sahasrara i. e. she who gives the very pleasant experience of the ultimate.
Om Thadillatha Samaruchya Namah - She who shines like the streak of lightning.
Om Shad Chakropari Samshitha Namah - She who is on the top of six wheels starting from mooladhara.
Om Maha Ssakthya Namah - She who likes worship by her devotees.
Om Kundalini Namah - She who is in the form of Kundalini (a form which is a snake hissing and exists in mooladhara).
Om Bisa Thanthu Thaniyasi Namah - She who is as thin as the thread from lotus.
Om Bhavani Namah - She who gives life to the routine life of human beings or She who is the consort of Lord Shiva.
Om Bhavana Gamya Namah - She who can be attained by thinking.
Om Bhavarany Kudariga Namah - She who is like the axe used to cut the miserable life of the world.
Om Bhadra Priya Namah - She who is interested in doing good to her devotees.
Om Bhadra Moorthy Namah - She who is personification of all that is good.
Om Bhaktha Sowbhagya Dhayini Namah - She who gives all good and luck to her devotees.
Om Bhakthi Priya Namah - She who likes devotion to her.
Om Bhakthi Gamya Namah - She who can be reached by devotion.
Om Bhakthi Vasya Namah - She who can be controlled by devotion.
Om Bhayapaha Namah - She who removes fear.
Om Sambhavya Namah - She who is married to Shambhu.
Om Saradharadya Namah - She who is to be worshipped during Navarathri celebrated during autumn.
Om Sarvani Namah - She who is the consort of Lord Shiva in the form of Sarvar.
Om Sarmadhayini Namah - She who gives pleasures.
Om Sankari Namah - She who is the consort of Sankara.
Om Sreekari Namah - She who gives all forms of wealth and happiness.
Om Sadhwi Namah - She who is eternally devoted to her husband.
Om Sarat Chandra Nibhanana Namah - She who has the face like moon in the autumn.
Om Satho Dhari Namah - She who has a thin belly.
Om Santhimathi Namah - She who is peace personified.
Om Niradhara Namah - She who does not need any support to herself.
Om Niranjana Namah - She who is devoid of any blemishes or scars.
Om Nirlepa Namah - She who does not have any attachment.
Om Nirmala Namah - She who is personification of clarity or She who is devoid of any dirt.
Om Nithya Namah - She who is permanently stable.
Om Nirakara Namah - She who does not have any shape.
Om Nirakula Namah - She who cannot be attained by confused people.
Om Nirguna Namah - She who is beyond any characteristics.
Om Nishkala Namah - She who is not divided.
Om Santha Namah - She who is peace.
Om Nishkama Namah - She who does not have any desires.
Om Niruppallava Namah - She who is never destroyed.
Om Nithya Muktha Namah - She who is forever free of the ties of the world.
Om Nirvikara Namah - She who never undergoes alteration.
Om Nishprapancha Namah - She who is beyond this world.
Om Nirasraya Namah - She who does not need support.
Om Nithya Shuddha Namah - She who is forever clean.
Om Nithya Bhuddha Namah - She who is for ever knowledge.
Om Niravadhya Namah - She who can never be accused.
Om Niranthara Namah - She who is forever continuous.
Om Nishkarana Namah - She who does not have cause.
Om Nishkalanka Namah - She who does not have blemishes.
Om Nirupadhi Namah - She who does not have basis.
Om Nireeswara Namah - She who does not have any one controlling her.
Om Neeraga Namah - She who does not have any desires.
Om Ragha Madhani Namah - She who removes desires from us.
Om Nirmadha Namah - She who does not have any firm beliefs.
Om Madhanasini Namah - She who destroys beliefs.
Om Nischintha Namah - She who is not worried.
Om Nirahankara Namah - She who does not have an ego.
Om Nirmoha Namah - She who does not have any passion.
Om Mohanasini Namah - She who destroys passion.
Om Nirmama Namah - She who does not have selfish feelings.
Om Mamatha Hanthri Namah - She who destroys selfishness.
Om Nishpapa Namah - She who does not have any sin.
Om Papa Nashini Namah - She who destroys sin.
Om Nishkrodha Namah - She who is devoid of anger.
Om Krodha -Samani Namah - She who destroys anger.
Om Nir Lobha Namah - She who is not miserly.
Om Lobha Nasini Namah - She who removes miserliness.
Om Nissamsaya Namah - She who does not have any doubts.
Om Samsayagni Namah - She who clears doubts.
Om Nirbhava Namah - She who does not have another birth.
Om Bhava Nasini Namah - She who helps us not have another birth.
Om Nirvikalpa Namah - She who does not do anything she does not desire.
Om Nirabhadha Namah - She who is not affected by anything.
Om Nirbhedha Namah - She who does not have any difference.
Om Bhedha Nasini Namah - She who promotes oneness.
Om Nirnasa Namah - She who does not die.
Om Mrityu Madhani Namah - She who removes fear of death.
Om Nishkriya Namah - She who does not have any work.
Om Nishparigraha Namah - She who does not accept help from others.
Om Nisthula Namah - She who does not have anything to be compared to.
Om Neela Chikura Namah - She who has dark black hair.
Om Nirapaya Namah - She who is never destroyed.
Om Nirathyaya Namah - She who does not cross limits of rules she herself created.
Om Dhurlabha Namah - She who is difficult to obtain.
Om Dhurgama Namah - She who can not be neared easily.
Om Dhurga Namah - She who is Dhurga who is a nine year old girl.
Om Dhuka Hanthri Namah - She who removes sorrows.
Om Sukha Prada Namah - She who gives pleasures and happiness.
Om Dushta Doora Namah - She who keeps far away from evil men.
Om Durachara Samani Namah - She who destroys evil practices.
Om Dosha Varjitha Namah - She who does not have anything bad.
Om Sarvangna Namah - She who knows everything.
Om Saandra Karuna Namah - She who is full of mercy.
Om Samanadhika Varjitha Namah - She who is incomparable.
Om Sarva Shakthi Mayi Namah - She who has personification of all strengths.
Om Sarva Mangala Namah - She who is personification of all that is good.
Om Sad Gathi Prada Namah - She who gives us good path.
Om Sarveshwari Namah - She who is goddess of all.
Om Sarva Mayi Namah - She who is everywhere.
Om Sarva Manthra Swaroopini Namah - She who is personification of all manthras.
Om Sarva Yanthrathmika Namah - She who is represented by all yantras (Talisman).
Om Sarva Thanthra Roopa Namah - She who is also goddess of all Thanthras (method of worship).
Om Manonmani Namah - She who is the result of mental thoughts of thoughts and actions.
Om Maaheswari Namah - She who is the consort of Maheswara (Lord of everything).
Om Mahaa Devi Namah - She who is the consort of Mahe Deva (God of all gods).
Om Maha Lakshmi Namah - She who takes the form of Mahalaksmi, the goddess of wealth.
Om Mrida Priya Namah - She who is dear to Mrida (a name of Lord Shiva).
Om Maha Roopa Namah - She who is very big.
Om Maha Poojya Namah - She who is fit to be worshipped by great people.
Om Maha Pathaka Nasini Namah - She who destroys the major misdemeanors.
Om Maha Maya Namah - She who is the great illusion.
Om Maha Sathva Namah - She who is greatly knowledgeable.
Om Maha Sakthi Namah - She who is very strong.
Om Maha Rathi Namah - She who gives great happiness.
Om Maha Bhoga Namah - She who enjoys great pleasures.
Om Mahaiswarya Namah - She who has great wealth.
Om Maha Veerya Namah - She who has great valour.
Om Maha Bala Namah - She who is very strong.
Om Maha Bhudhi Namah - She who is very intelligent.
Om Maha Sidhi Namah - She who has great super natural powers.
Om Maha Yogeswareswari Namah - She who is goddess of great yogis.
Om Mahathanthra Namah - She who has the greatest Thantra sasthras.
Om Mahamanthra Namah - She who has the greatest manthras.
Om Mahayanthra Namah - She who has the greatest yanthras.
Om Mahasana Namah - She who has the greatest seat.
Om Maha Yaga Kramaradhya Namah - She who should be worshipped by performing great sacrifices (Bhavana yaga and Chidagni Kunda yaga).
Om Maha Bhairava Poojitha Namah - She who is being worshipped by the great Bhairava.
Om Maheswara Mahakalpa Maha Thandava Sakshini Namah - She who will be the witness to the great dance to be performed by the great lord at the end of the worlds.
Om Maha Kamesha Mahishi Namah - She who is the prime consort of the great Kameshwara.
Om Maha Tripura Sundari Namah - She who is the beauty of the three great cities.
Om Chatustatyupacharadya Namah - She who should be worshipped with sixty four offerings.
Om Chathu Sashti Kala Mayi Namah - She who has sixty four sections.
Om Maha Chathusashti Kodi Yogini Gana Sevitha Namah - She who is being worshipped by the sixty four crore yoginis in the nine different charkas.
Om Manu Vidya Namah - She who is personification of Sri Vidya as expounded by Manu.
Om Chandra Vidya Namah - She who is personification of Sri Vidya as expounded by Moon.
Om Chandra Mandala Madhyaga Namah - She who is in the center of the universe around the moon.
Om Charu Roopa Namah - She who is very beautiful.
Om Charu Hasa Namah - She who has a beautiful smile.
Om Charu Chandra Kaladhara Namah - She who wears the beautiful crescent.
Om Charachara Jagannatha Namah - She who is the Lord of all moving and immobile things.
Om Chakra Raja Nikethana Namah - She who lives in the middle of Sree Chakra.
Om Parvathi Namah - She who is the daughter of the mountain.
Om Padma Nayana Namah - She who has eyes like the lotus.
Om Padma Raga Samaprabha Namah - She who shines as much as the Padma Raga jewel.
Om Pancha Prethasana Seena Namah - She who sits on the seat of five dead bodies (these are Brahma, Vishnu, Rudra, Eesa and Sadasiva without their Shakthi (consort)).
Om Pancha Brahma Swaroopini Namah - She who is personification of five brahmas (they are the gods mentioned in the last name with their Shakthi).
Om Chinmayi Namah - She who is the personification action in every thing.
Om Paramananda Namah - She who is supremely happy.
Om Vignana Gana Roopini Namah - She who is the personification of knowledge based on science.
Om Dhyana Dhyathru Dhyeya Roopa Namah - She who is personification of meditation, the being who meditates and what is being meditated upon.
Om Dharmadhrama Vivarjitha Namah - She who is beyond Kustice and Injustice.
Om Viswa Roopa Namah - She who has the form of the universe.
Om Jagarini Namah - She who is always awake.
Om Swapanthi Namah - She who is always in the state of dream.
Om Thaijasathmika Namah - She who is the form of Thaijasa which is microbial concept.
Om Suptha Namah - She who is in deep sleep.
Om Prangnathmika Namah - She who is awake.
Om Thurya Namah - She who is in trance.
Om Sarvavastha Vivarjitha Namah - She who is above all states.
Om Srishti Karthri Namah - She who creates.
Om Brahma Roopa Namah - She who is the personification of ultimate.
Om Gopthri Namah - She who saves.
Om Govinda Roopini Namah - She who is of the form of Govinda.
Om Samharini Namah - She who destroys.
Om Rudhra Roopa Namah - She who is of the form of Rudhra.
Om Thirodhana Kari Namah - She who hides herself from us.
Om Eeswari Namah - She who is of the form of easwara.
Om Sadashivaa Namah - She who is of the form of Sadashiva.
Om Anugrahada Namah - She who blesses.
Om Pancha Krithya Parayana Namah - She who is engaged in the five duties of creation, existence, dissolving, disappearing, and blessing.
Om Bhanu Mandala Madhyastha Namah - She who is in the middle of the sun's universe.
Om Bhairavi Namah - She who is the consort of Bhairava.
Om Bhaga Malini Namah - She who is the goddess Bhaga Malini.
Om Padmasana Namah - She who sits on a lotus.
Om Bhagavathi Namah - She who is with all wealth and knowledge.
Om Padmanabha Sahodari Namah - She who is the sister of Vishnu.
Om Unmesha Nimishotpanna Vipanna Bhuvanavali Namah - She who creates and destroys the universe by opening and closing of her eye lids.
Om Sahasra Seersha Vadana Namah - She who has thousands of faces and heads.
Om Saharakshi Namah - She who has thousands of eyes.
Om Sahasra Path Namah - She who has thousands of feet.
Om Aabrahma Keeda Janani Namah - She who has created all beings from worm to Lord Brahma.
Om Varnashrama Vidhayini Namah - She who created the four fold division of society.
Om Nijangna Roopa Nigama Namah - She who gave orders which are based on Vedas.
Om Punyapunya Phala Pradha Namah - She who gives compensation for sins and good deeds.
Om Sruthi Seemantha Kula Sindhoori Kritha Padabjha Dhooliga Namah - She whose dust from her lotus feet is the sindhoora fills up in the parting of the hair of the Vedic mother.
Om Sakalagama Sandoha Shukthi Samputa Maukthika Namah - She who is like the pearl in the pearl holding shell of Vedas.
Om Purashartha Pradha Namah - She who gives us the purusharthas of Charity, assets, joy and moksha.
Om Poorna Namah - She who is complete.
Om Bhogini Namah - She who enjoys pleasures.
Om Bhuvaneshwari Namah - She who is the Goddess presiding over the universe.
Om Ambika Namah - She who is the mother of the world.
Om Anadhi Nidhana Namah - She who does not have either end or beginning.
Om Hari Brahmendra Sevitha Namah - She who is served by Gods like Vishnu, Indra and Brahma.
Om Naarayani Namah - She who is like Narayana.
